name: Boot — the page loads and the game starts

steps.label: load the game
the boot overlay clears
steps.expr: const b = document.getElementById('boot'); if (!b) return true; return b.classList.contains('hidden');

steps.label: boot did not fail
the launch menu is the front door
the dock is hidden behind the menu
the menu has a painted background
steps.expr: const c=document.getElementById('menubg'); if(!c||getComputedStyle(c).display==='none') return false; const x=c.getContext('2d'); const d=x.getImageData(0,0,Math.min(c.width,64),Math.min(c.height,64)).data; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){if(d[i]||d[i+1]||d[i+2])return true;} return false;

steps.label: the title screen
the title screen leads with PLAY, not a save list
press PLAY
steps.expr: const b=document.querySelector('.sq-launch-play'); if(!b) return 'no play button'; b.click(); return 'clicked';

steps.label: the saves screen appears after PLAY
choose a save from the launch menu
steps.expr: const bs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sq-launch-root button')];const pick=bs.find(x=>/continue/i.test(x.textContent||''))||bs.find(x=>/^\s*load/i.test(x.textContent||''));if(!pick) return 'no continue/load button: '+bs.map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|');pick.click(); return pick.textContent.trim();

steps.label: the launch menu steps aside
the canvas exists and has been sized
steps.expr: const c = document.getElementById('stage'); return !!c && c.width > 0 && c.height > 0;

steps.label: the canvas has actually been painted
steps.expr: const c = document.getElementById('stage'); const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); const w = Math.min(c.width, 96), h = Math.min(c.height, 96); const d = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { if (d[i] || d[i+1] || d[i+2]) return true; } return false;

steps.label: the native menu bridge is present
the server hands over state
dock buttons present (informational)
